_README: Mechanical risk-tier floor. A classifier (or any agent) proposes a tier in change-classification.md / tasks.yml; this policy is the safety net that prevents a high-risk surface from being silently under-classified. `cdd-kit gate` and `cdd-kit classify-check` scan change-request.md (and, when available, the change's touched paths) for these patterns and require the declared tier to be at least as strict as the matched floor. Lower tier number = stricter. Set enabled:false to disable, or record `tier-floor-override: "<reason>"` in a change's tasks.yml frontmatter to bypass for one change with an audit trail.

rules.label: critical surface (auth / payments / data migration / concurrency / secrets)
behavioral surface (api / data shape / queue / cache / external integration)
